[authoritative] [scholarly]
Duniya ki sabse purani medical texts mein se ek... ancient China ka Pen-ts'ao Ching... jo Emperor Shen Nung ko attributed hai.

[serious] [informative]
Isme cannabis ka zikr hai... joint pain ke liye... malaria ke liye... aur even absent-mindedness ke liye.

[blunt] [serious]
Lekin ek baat clear karna zaroori hai.

[conversational] [reflective]
Us zamane ke insaan cannabis ko waise nahi dekhte the jaise aaj tum sochte ho.

[serious] [authoritative]
Nasha... sirf ek chota part tha. Real value practical thi... rope... kapda... khana... dawa.

[scholarly] [confident]
Aur modern archaeology bhi yahi confirm karti hai... cannabis ka early domestication mostly fiber aur food ke liye tha.

[serious] [deliberate]
Psychoactive ritual use baad mein... alag se develop hua.

[staccato] [authoritative]
Pehle kaam... baad mein ritual.

[mysterious] [dramatic]
Aur woh ritual... jab shuru hui... toh usne ek aisa raasta liya jo aaj bhi hairan karta hai.
